note: Real digests for version 0.1.5, built from the plugin repository's main branch at commit 650df30cb661 (make release-with-prebuilt-fpp10 VERSION=0.1.5). This version adds the night subcommand the seven ShowMesh night FPP commands call, and includes everything built into the 0.1.4 candidate. Those artifacts are a private candidate build, not a published release, so the default artifact host still serves nothing for this version; the digests are what a bench or a later publication of that same build must match. Regenerate this file from the manifest whenever a new release is cut; there is no tooling that does it automatically. The three native-prebuilt-fpp10 objects were built once each on an Apple Silicon Mac under Docker Desktop for this candidate; no second host has rebuilt and compared them.
